fee_notes: Royalty is 5% of Gross Sales, due the 10th day of each 28-day reporting period. Brand Fund Contribution is 1% of Gross Sales; franchisor has the right to increase total combined marketing obligation (inclusive of local marketing at 2% of Gross Sales, Brand Fund Contribution, and any Cooperative contribution) up to 5% of Gross Sales. Cooperative Contributions are variable as directed by franchisor. Additional fees include collection costs, early termination damages (calculated as average weekly Royalty Fees and Brand Fund contributions for the prior year multiplied by the lesser of 48 periods or remaining periods), enforcement expenses, indemnification, interest at 1.5% per month or maximum permitted by law, and on-site assistance fees.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty: 5% of Gross Sales, 10th day of each 28-day reporting period ("Period"). See Note 3 for the definition of "Gross Sales"; see Note 4 for an explanation of our electronic funds transfer process.
Brand Fund Contribution: 1% of Gross Sales, 10th day of each Period. We have the right to increase your periodic total combined marketing obligation up to 5% of Gross Sales; that total obligation would be inclusive of your local marketing expenditure obligation, which is currently 2% of Gross Sales, the Brand Fund Contribution and any Cooperative contribution.
Cooperative Contributions: As directed by us, As directed by us.
Collection Costs and Expenses: Amount incurred, Upon demand.
Early Termination Damages: Amount of the average weekly Royalty Fees and Brand Fund contributions that you owed for the one year period prior to termination, multiplied by the lesser of 48 Periods or the number of Periods remaining in the term of the Franchise Agreement, Within 30 days following termination.
Enforcement Expenses: Actual cost of our attorneys' fees and expenses, Upon demand.
Indemnification: Our actual costs and expenses, As incurred.
Interest: 1.5% per month or the maximum rate permitted by applicable law, whichever is less, With payment of overdue amount.
On-Site Assistance Fee: Actual expenses and salaries of our personnel including travel expenses, accommodations, and meals, Upon demand.
